method: Visual inspection of all 24 original generated boards / 96 scenes for cel-shaded anime style, slender balanced silhouettes, relevant locations and activities, school-age role context and labels; all central grid boundaries checked with pixel profiles.

issues.finding: Previous scene figures used inconsistent semi-realistic rendering and silhouettes; school contexts used adult/university assumptions.
issues.resolution: Original redraw of all 96 scene examples in clear anime linework and cel shading. Secondary-school students, adult teachers, boarding-school tracksuits and school-uniform graduation are explicit. SNW005 renamed without changing its ID; SNG001 is a teenage magic-school student.
